title: Calibration orchestration: provenance-aware runs, TTL tiers, and access gating for INT8/FP8 profiles
creator: Priya Nair
description: Overview: We need orchestration primitives in the Redwood Console for calibration runs that produce FP8/INT8 quantization artifacts with full provenance, tiered retention, and permissioned access. Current calibration jobs are ad-hoc: teams run experiments via scripts or CI and upload artifacts to disparate buckets. This ticket proposes a first-class calibration run model in Console that tracks inputs (model checkpoint, calibration dataset snapshot, sampling seed), execution environment (hardware profile, runtime image, container hash), validation outputs (accuracy delta vs golden baseline, eval metrics), and artifact lifecycle policies (hot/archival TTL, auto-delete, and custodian roles). The goal is to make calibration reproducible, auditable, and safe to consume in Dedicated/Private deployments while minimizing long-term storage costs and enforcing security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Console can create a Calibration Run resource with required fields: model_version, dataset_snapshot_id, run_config (quant_mode, target_dtype), compute_target, and run_schedule
Every completed run stores a provenance manifest: input hashes, container image digest, command-line, RNG seed, KV cache snapshot id (optional), and timestamp
Artifact retention tiers are configurable per-run: hot (30d), warm (90d), cold (365d) with ability to attach KMS key and archival destination
RBAC: roles 'calibration-run-owner', 'calibration-viewer', and 'calibration-custodian' enforced; run artifacts default to owner-only unless widened

Accuracy validation step computes at least 3 metrics (top-k accuracy, token-level divergence, task-specific F1) and records delta vs golden baseline; failure threshold triggers automatic mark 'regression'
Console UI surfaces cost estimate for run based on compute_target and expected sample size before submit
Runs support canary sampling mode (1% examples) and full-run mode with automatic promotion workflow after manual/automated gate approval
proposed_workflow: 1) User creates 'Calibration Run' in Console or via API with model_version + dataset snapshot + quant profile (INT8/FP8) + schedule. 2) System validates inputs, shows cost/time estimate, and queues job on selected compute pool (hosted vs dedicated). 3) Job executes in an isolated runtime image; a provenance manifest (JSON) is atomically written with run metadata and immutable hashes. 4) Post-run: validation suite runs against a golden eval set; metrics and artifacts (quant profile, calibration traces, per-layer scale tables) are stored in a structured artifact store and attached to the run. 5) Retention policy applies: hot artifacts kept per TTL; older artifacts moved to cold storage or purged. 6) Access is enforced by RBAC; custodians may extend retention or promote artifacts to 'materialized profile' for serving. 7) Audit entries and optional Slack/email notifications are emitted for every lifecycle event.
ui_notes: Calibration run create flow should: 1) allow selection of predefined quant presets (INT8 symmetric/asymmetric, FP8 bfloat-like variants), 2) show interactive cost slider that updates estimate, 3) provide 'provenance preview' that lists required immutable inputs, 4) include approvals: optional 'Require QA approval' toggle that gates promotion, 5) show retention dropdown with recommended tier based on customer SLA.
api_contract: POST /api/v1/calibration_runs -> returns run_id. Required payload keys: model_version (string), dataset_snapshot (string), quant_profile (string), compute_target (string), retention_tier (string), kms_key_id (optional), canary_fraction (optional). GET /api/v1/calibration_runs/{id} returns manifest URL, metrics, artifact urls. PATCH allows retention extension by custodians. DELETE only allowed for custodians and must log reason.
validation_metrics_spec: Minimal validation must include: (1) DeltaAccuracy: relative change vs golden baseline on task-specific eval set; (2) TokenKL: mean KL divergence on token distributions; (3) LatencyVariance: p95 latency delta under target batch size; plus optional downstream task F1/EM. Each metric records: value, baseline_value, unit, sample_count, seed. Console displays pass/fail against thresholds configured per project.
data_governance_and_retention: Runs must optionally attach a dataset_snapshot record which is an immutable pointer to the dataset version hash. Artifact retention tiers: HOT (default 30 days, fast access), WARM (90 days, infrequent access), COLD (365+ days, archived, restore-on-demand). Custodian role can mark an artifact as Permanent with justification and audit entry. Retention transitions must be logged; automatic GC should send a pre-delete notification 7 days before purge.
rbac_and_permissions: Three roles proposed: calibration-run-owner (create, run, promote), calibration-viewer (view metadata and download artifacts if allowed), calibration-custodian (extend retention, delete, promote to serving). Cross-org access should be prevented by default; cross-team access requires an explicit grant with expiration. All access events are logged to the audit log with SSO identity, action, timestamp, and optional reason.
security_considerations: - Enforce KMS encryption on artifacts for Private deployments; UI must show which KMS key will be used. - Container images executed for calibration must be validated against a signed image whitelist; digest must be recorded. - Calibration manifests and artifact URLs should support signed short-lived URLs for downloads (default 7 days). - Sensitive datasets must be designated as 'restricted' and never move to cold/archival without a data owner approval workflow.
operational_and_cost_notes: - Provide a cost estimator that factors GPU hours, storage (hot/warm/cold), and egress. - Support preemptible/spot compute targets with retry/backoff policies and fallback to non-preemptible pools. - Queue prioritization: production-critical runs can be forced into a high-priority queue with dedicated capacity (billing implications shown). - Provide a 'dry-run' mode that performs only the validation pipeline (no full calibration) to estimate quality delta quickly.
migration_path_from_current: 1) Add 'Calibration Run' resource and API while leaving existing uploads supported. 2) Backfill provenance manifests for top 50 active teams by replaying historical runs where artifacts and logs exist. 3) Provide a one-click 'import into Console' flow for external calibration artifacts with a verification step. 4) Deprecate ad-hoc upload after 3 months with migration guidance.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Large teams may store many artifacts leading to storage bloat. Mitigation: enforce default hot->warm->cold lifecycle and require custodian approval to mark Permanent. Risk: Wrong quant profile promoted to serving causing production regressions. Mitigation: require a promotion gate with either manual QA approval or automated canary rollout tied to evaluation thresholds. Risk: Unauthorized access to dataset snapshots. Mitigation: restrict dataset export and require dataset owner approval for cross-team attachments.
test_plan: - End-to-end: create run, execute canary, validate metrics, promote artifact, and extend retention as custodian. - Security: attempt downloads with expired signed URL, attempt retention extend as non-custodian, verify audit log entries. - Performance: simulate 100 concurrent calibration runs and observe queue behavior and cost estimator accuracy. - UX: user acceptance testing of create flow, provenance preview, and cost slider.
notes: Follow-on work: expose an event stream for CI to subscribe to run completions, and add a lightweight SDK helper to fetch latest approved quant profile for a model. Consider future feature: profile diff viewer that highlights per-layer scale changes between two quant profiles.
